$comment: The compatibility record for the Munarium client libraries. Generated and maintained by hand at release time. Update this file, never the historical notes in README.md, which are a dated changelog of what was true when they were written.
policy: Each Clients minor release supports the current Server minor and the one before it (N and N-1). A breaking MMP wire change bumps mmp_contract_major; Server serves both majors for one Server minor release so Clients can move without a flag day. Clients version independently of Server: a shared version number on a given release is a coincidence of that release, not a rule.
note: This is the first public release of the server, Matrix and every client, all at 1.0.0. The N-1 half of the policy therefore has nothing to name yet: there is no 0.x in public and no predecessor in scope. When the server ships 1.1, the next release's supported_server becomes ["1.1", "1.0"] per client, and the same for supported_matrix. The policy is stated now so that it binds from the first release rather than being introduced later. Entries carrying `speaks_to: matrix` are the Munarium Matrix clients; they version against Matrix, not against the server. The Rust client path-depends on munarium-api-types and munarium-proto, which are server crates: both must reach crates.io before munarium-client can be published there.
